name: Yvet
source:
"I refuse to forgive whoever it was that laid hand on my husband. I'll do whatever it takes to expose them and send them to hell with my own two hands."

The heroine of this story. She grew up as an orphan on the Mainland and worked for a death squad. Francis's father, Yeung Kwun, took her in after her breaking out of that group.

[From [url=http://www.rpgdl.org/rsl/en.html#character]official site[/url]]
